user.title: Connect your Kindle reading history
user.description: Kindle has no public API, so this integration reads the Goodreads account your Kindle syncs to. Enable it on your Kindle under Settings → Your Account → Social Networks → Goodreads, Then paste your private RSS link from Goodreads (My Books → RSS link at the bottom of the page) so your shelves can stay private. A public profile URL or user ID also works.

data.user_id: Goodreads RSS link, profile URL or user ID
data.reading_shelf: Shelf with the book you are reading

error.invalid_user_id: Paste your Goodreads RSS link, a profile URL like https://www.goodreads.com/user/show/12345-name, or a numeric user ID
error.user_not_found: Goodreads refused the request. If your profile is private, paste the RSS link from My Books, which includes your private key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not fetch the Goodreads feed
